subject: general
question: Borneo, Java and Sumatra are islands of which of the following archipelagos?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Greater Sundas (Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and Celebes), the Lesser Sundas, the Moluccas, and western New Guinea **are the main islands and island groups that make up the **Republic of Indonesia.**
 
• The Philippines' main islands are Mindanao in the south, Luzon in the north, and the Visayas in the middle.</li
